events.title: Fidelity National Financial (FNF) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Lag Estimates
events.body: Fidelity National Financial (FNF) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -15.05% and -11.86%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
